title: Who Licks the Cake?
lines: Jane and Mom bake a big cake.
They set the cake on a flat rock.
Jane runs in to get a rag.
When she gets back, the cake has a lick!
"Who did that?" said Jane. Mom thinks a bug.
But Jane spots cake on Jake the cat's chin.
"It was Jake!" said Jane. "Look at his chin."
"We can make Jake a small cake," said Jane.
They bake it, and Jake laps it up.
Then Jane and Mom take the big cake in.

questions.ask: Where did Jane and Mom put the big cake?
questions.listenFor: On a flat rock. Line two says it. Let your child reread rather than being told.

questions.ask: Mom thinks a bug licked the cake. How does Jane show it was not a bug?
questions.listenFor: She spots cake on Jake the cat's chin. Line six is the clue - it is worth a little talk.

questions.ask: What do you think Jake will do next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any guess is fine if it has a reason from the story, like "go back to the rock, because that is where the cake was."
